name: mOS 1.0 Amber (0.7)
notes: Real Liquid Glass: the taskbar, Start, Control Centre, menus and pop-ups bend light at their edges, with a shine that follows your mouse
Pop-ups drop out of the taskbar like a droplet, and glass that touches melts together
New widget gallery like iOS and macOS, with new Calendar, Weather and Notes widgets in small, medium and large
New mOS right-click menu on the desktop
New lock screen like Windows 11 and sign-in like Windows 7, with your picture in a glass frame
Pick a different picture for the lock screen and the sign-in screen
Steadier Wi-Fi on the MacBook Air 2017, also after sleep
Setup after installing is full screen, and Install mOS sits on the live USB desktop
